sites.name: Dong Loc Junction Relic Site
sites.event: A symbol of indomitable spirit, marking the heroic sacrifice of 10 young female volunteers and the traffic assurance forces during the resistance war against the US.

sites.name: Great Poet Nguyen Du Relic Site
sites.event: The hometown and resting place of World Cultural Celebrity Nguyen Du, author of the masterpiece 'Truyen Kieu'.

sites.name: Huong Tich Pagoda
sites.event: Known as 'Hoan Chau de nhat danh lam' (The most beautiful scenic spot in the Nghe region), located on the peak of Hong Linh Mountain.

sites.name: Thien Cam Beach
sites.event: Associated with the legend of King Ho Quy Ly hearing the waves crashing against the mountain caves, echoing sounds like a lute (Thien Cam means Heavenly Lute).

sites.name: Ke Go Lake
sites.event: A famous large artificial lake, featured in the song 'Nguoi di xay ho Ke Go', nestled amidst vast natural forests and mountains.

sites.name: Cui Temple (Cho Cui Temple)
sites.event: The sacred place of worship for Quan Hoang Muoi, an important spiritual destination in the worship of the Mother Goddesses of the Three Realms (Tam Phu).

sites.name: Hoanh Son Quan (Heaven's Gate - Ngang Pass)
sites.event: A historic gateway guarding the peak of Ngang Pass, the former boundary between Dai Viet and Champa, and the inspiration for the poem 'Qua Deo Ngang'.

sites.name: General Secretary Tran Phu Relic Site
sites.event: The memorial site for Comrade Tran Phu - the first General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam, author of the 1930 Political Thesis.

sites.name: Vu Quang National Park
sites.event: An ASEAN Heritage Park, where the rare Saola was discovered, and once the base of Phan Dinh Phung's insurgent army (Can Vuong movement).

sites.name: General Secretary Ha Huy Tap Relic Site
sites.event: The place preserving memorabilia of the life and revolutionary career of the late General Secretary Ha Huy Tap.

sites.name: Son Kim Hot Mineral Spring
sites.event: An eco-resort with a natural hot mineral water source gushing from the ground.
